title: MISO SLAM Reproduction: Multi-Implicit-Submaps on Newer College Dataset
short_description: Automated reproduction of the MISO SLAM pipeline on Chameleon Bare Metal GPU nodes.
long_description: This artifact reproduces the MISO SLAM system for large-scale 3D reconstruction. It automates the provisioning of a GPU-enabled Bare Metal node, handles complex environment setup (PyTorch 1.13, PyTorch3D, pysdf), and runs the SLAM pipeline on the Newer College Quad dataset.
